Title: Consumer Risk Specialist
Description: Job Description Why GM Financial? GM Financial is the wholly owned captive finance subsidiary of General Motors and is headquartered in Fort Worth, U.S. We are a global provider of auto finance solutions, with operations in North America, South America, and the Asia Pacific region. Through our long-standing relationships with auto dealers, we offer attractive retail financing and lease programs to meet the needs of each customer. We also offer commercial lending products to dealers to help them finance and grow their businesses. At GM Financial, our team members define and shape our culture — an environment that welcomes new ideas, fosters integrity, and creates a sense of community and belonging. Here we do more than work — we thrive. Our Purpose: We pioneer the innovations that move and connect people to what matters. This position will be posted until filled. Responsibilities About the Role The Risk Consumer Specialist is a senior individual contributor responsible for providing advanced credit risk analytics and leading risk initiatives that support profitable and sustainable business growth while maintaining appropriate risk disciplines and appetite. The role will have a strong focus on consumer credit risk, covering credit policies, originations, credit decisioning, portfolio performance, risk segmentation, and emerging risk identification. This position is expected to translate complex data and portfolio trends into actionable risk strategies, provide recommendations to senior stakeholders, and act as a key point of connection between Consumer Risk, Credit Operations, Analytics, Technology, and central/global Risk teams. The role requires a high degree of autonomy, analytical judgment, business understanding, and ownership of initiatives, operating as a subject matter expert across different components of the consumer credit risk lifecycle.The position provides leadership and oversight across Credit Origination, Portfolio Risk Management, Leasing & Residual Values, Credit Loss Reserves, and Credit Decisioning Platforms, ensuring effective governance, risk measurement, controls, and decision-making throughout the credit lifecycle. In This Role You Will Manage and oversee credit decisioning platforms from a Risk perspective, ensuring credit policies, strategies and decision rules are appropriately implemented and aligned with business and risk requirements. Serve as the primary Consumer Risk point of contact for Credit Operations on matters related to decisioning platforms, credit policies, system functionality and credit strategy implementation. Coordinate with central and global teams on the implementation, enhancement and evolution of credit decisioning tools and capabilities, representing Mexico Consumer Risk requirements and priorities. Partner with Credit Operations, Technology, Analytics and central teams to translate risk strategies and business requirements into decisioning capabilities and system requirements. Identify opportunities to improve efficiency and simplify credit decisioning processes, including increased automation, reduced manual intervention and improvements in the effectiveness of the credit evaluation process. Define and develop the analytics and monitoring framework for credit decisioning platforms, establishing relevant indicators to assess strategy performance, decision outcomes, overrides, declines, referrals and other key decisioning trends. Develop, assess, validate and monitor consumer credit policies and underwriting strategies, ensuring alignment with risk appetite, business objectives and market conditions. Perform advanced analysis of consumer portfolio performance, identifying emerging risks, changes in customer behavior and opportunities to strengthen portfolio quality. Monitor relevant risk indicators across the credit lifecycle, including delinquency, losses, vintages, roll rates and other portfolio performance measures. Perform ad hoc risk analyses, data assessments and strategic evaluations as business needs arise, translating complex information into actionable insights, recommendations and risk proposals to support management decision-making. Qualifications What makes You an ideal candidate? Knowledge of portfolio performance indicators, including delinquency, roll rates, vintage analysis, losses, recoveries, expected losses, and risk-adjusted profitability. Understanding of credit decisioning platforms, rules-based strategies, model implementation, testing, monitoring, and controlled change management. Ability to communicate credibly and effectively with regulators, auditors, executive management, and governance committees. Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to connect detailed data findings to commercial, financial, and strategic decisions. Business and financial acumen, with the ability to understand the impact of risk decisions on growth, profitability, reserves, and customer experience. Proficiency in data analysis and management reporting tools. Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills in Spanish and English. Work Experience & Education Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Actuarial Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, Business Administration, Data Analytics or a related quantitative field. Relevant professional experience in Credit Risk, Consumer Finance, Financial Services, Risk Analytics or Credit Strategy. What We Offer At GM Financial we want you to be the most authentic version of yourself. We take care of your work-life balance by programming wellness and integration activities, where you will strengthen your relationships with peers and contribute towards the development and wellbeing of your community, while providing you with a competitive salary and benefits. Some of our global benefits include Extended Maternity & Paternity Leaves, Personal Days & Community Investment hours. GM Financial is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Title: Sr. Data Scientist, Financial Services Mexico
Description: Description Lead the development, validation, and governance of the full suite of risk models for a high-growth payment product in Mexico, directly shaping the analytical foundation that drives every business decision across the product lifecycle. If you thrive on building scorecards from the ground up — starting with external data and expert-rule frameworks when proprietary data does not yet exist, then architecting the transition to custom models as portfolio mature — this is your opportunity to establish and scale a risk modeling function from inception. As Sr. Data Scientist, you will own the end-to-end model roadmap spanning origination, behavioral, delinquency propensity, collections, recovery, analytical fraud, and reserve input models. You will define development standards, documentation practices, versioning protocols, and monitoring frameworks with the rigor required to withstand audit scrutiny and regulatory review. Your work is both tactical and strategic: you will manage complex, cross-functional model programs with negotiated and defined obligations, influencing roadmaps, business and technology decisions, and model governance across the organization. Success in this role is measured by discriminatory power (KS, Gini) and its stability over time, Population Stability Index (PSI) of variables and scores, development-to-implementation cycle time, and the absence of validation findings. In a new product, the first 12 to 18 months are typically operated with generic or bureau scorecards and expert rules; this role requires someone who knows how to launch without proprietary data and plan the deliberate transition to custom models built on proprietary performance data as vintages mature. Key job responsibilities You will own and execute the model roadmap covering origination scorecards, behavioral scorecards, delinquency propensity models, collections and recovery models, analytical fraud models, and reserve inputs (PD, LGD, EAD). You will manage the full model lifecycle: development, validation, approval, implementation, ongoing monitoring, recalibration, and retirement. You will develop the origination scorecard, including reject inference methodology, and lead feature engineering across external data sources, and partner transactional data. You will build behavioral scorecards,payment propensity, contactability, and recovery models and produce PD, LGD, and EAD inputs for reserves calculation. You will own model validation end-to-end: conducting conceptual soundness reviews, replicating results, performing stress testing and stability analysis, and issuing formal opinions with findings, severity classifications, and remediation timelines. You will produce complete technical documentation and model files to the standard required for third-party review. A day in the life You will join working sessions with the risk team to translate champion/challenger experiment results into model refinement priorities, and calibrate payment propensity and contactability models against real-world recovery outcomes. You will coordinate with engineering to validate that deployed model versions match approved specifications and prepare the model performance package for the credit and risk committees. About The Team We are a team at Amazon building a new business, and we sit within the Payments organization. Today the team is small by design, which means you will have an outsized role in shaping our credit risk function, processes, and culture from day one. Our closest partners span finance, technology, and commercial teams, and together we are investing in creating a world-class underwriting and credit risk capability. If you want to help define something new at Amazon and see your work directly reflected in the product, we would love to hear from you. Basic Qualifications 5+ years of data querying languages (e.g. SQL), scripting languages (e.g. Python) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g. R, SAS, Matlab, etc.) experience 4+ years of data scientist experience Experience with statistical models e.g. multinomial logistic regression Preferred Qualifications 2+ years of data visualization using AWS QuickSight, Tableau, R Shiny, etc. experience Experience managing data pipelines Experience as a leader and mentor on a data science team Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to convert data into actionable insights. Proficiency in MS Excel and MS PowerPoint. If your last few years have been spent in meetings about data rather than working with data, this isn't the right fit. What You Will Do: Lead a delivery squad. You'll run a pod of 4-8 data engineers (employees and contractors) assembled against a business outcome. You set the technical direction, decompose work, manage sprint-level execution, and are accountable for what the squad ships. When the initiative concludes or transitions to steady state, you and your engineers move to the next priority. Build with your hands. You write code. You build pipelines. You debug production issues. You're comfortable in SQL, Python, and Spark, and you use them regularly, not as a party trick, but as your primary tools. When something is broken or behind, you can step in and do the work, not just escalate it. Design before you build. You think in terms of data models, medallion architectures, ingestion contracts, and reusable patterns. You design solutions that are maintainable and that the next engineer can understand without an archaeology expedition. You care about schema evolution, data quality checks, idempotency, and lineage, not because someone told you to, but because you've been burned when those things were missing. Engage with the business. You're not building pipelines into a void. You'll work directly with Engagement Leads and business stakeholders to understand what they need, why they need it, and what "done" looks like. You translate business problems into data solutions and push back when what's being asked for doesn't make technical sense. You're comfortable in a room with non-technical leaders and can explain complexity without hiding behind jargon. Drive engineering standards. CI/CD, version control, testing, code review, documentation: these aren't aspirational for you, they're how you've always worked. You'll bring these practices to your squad and raise the bar for everyone around you. You care about developer experience and operational excellence, not just feature delivery. You'll work with infrastructure-as-code, Git-based workflows, and pipeline orchestration tooling. If you've spent the last several years in the Databricks ecosystem, great. If you've built equivalent capabilities on other modern platforms and can ramp quickly, that works too. What We're Looking For: Essential: 5+ years of hands-on data engineering experience, with at least some time leading or mentoring other engineers Strong proficiency in SQL, Python, and Spark, used recently and regularly, not years ago Real experience with cloud data platforms (Databricks strongly preferred; Snowflake, Synapse, or similar accepted) on AWS, Azure, or GCP Demonstrated ability to lead a mixed team of employees and contractors: setting expectations, managing performance, building cohesion across employment types Fluency with modern engineering practices: Git, CI/CD, automated testing, infrastructure-as-code, DataOps The instinct to understand why something is being built, not just how. Title: Business Analyst, Cyber and Data Resilience
Description: We are seeking a detail-oriented Business Analyst to support our Operations and Sales leadership teams within Cyber & Data Resilience (CDR) in Mexico. This role will play a critical part in ensuring high-quality sales data, producing reliable reports, and translating sales activity into clear, actionable insights for leadership decision-making. Based in Mexico City, this role is designed for an analyst with 2+ years of experience who is comfortable working with structured data, collaborating with global stakeholders, and operating in a process-driven, high-accountability environment. Day To Day Responsibilities Salesforce Data Quality & Governance Review and validate Salesforce opportunity records to ensure data accuracy, completeness, and consistency (e.g., required fields, stage hygiene, attribution fields). Perform routine data quality checks and proactively flag data issues or trends to Sales Operations and business stakeholders. Partner with Sales Ops to support data standards, definitions, and usage guidelines across the sales lifecycle. Reporting & Dashboards Build and maintain standard sales and pipeline reports using Salesforce, Excel, and BI tools (e.g., Power BI where applicable). Support recurring reporting cadences (weekly, monthly, quarterly) for sales performance, pipeline health, and forecasting inputs. Ensure reports are timely, accurate, and clearly explained, with appropriate commentary on trends and drivers. Sales & Performance Insights Analyze sales data to identify patterns, risks, and opportunities across pipeline, win/loss, and deal progression. Translate data into concise insights for leadership reporting, highlighting “what changed,” “why it matters,” and “what to watch.” Support ad hoc analysis requests from Sales and Commercial Operations teams. Leadership & Stakeholder Support Contribute data analysis and supporting materials for leadership reviews and executive-level reporting. Work closely with global stakeholders across time zones, ensuring clarity, responsiveness, and strong follow-through. Document assumptions, logic, and data sources to support transparency and repeatability. Essential Traits 2+ years of experience as a Sales Analyst, Sales Operations Analyst, Business Analyst, or similar role. High attention to detail and a strong sense of data ownership and accountability. Hands-on experience working with Salesforce (reporting, opportunity data, fields, and basic data validation). Strong proficiency in Excel (lookups, pivots, basic data modeling). Experience preparing management or leadership-facing reports. A disciplined, process-oriented analyst who cares deeply about data quality. Someone who can move beyond reporting to provide meaningful insights. A team player who is comfortable operating in a matrixed, global organization. An individual motivated to grow into broader analytics or business operations responsibilities over time. Prerequisites Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Engineering, or a related analytical field. Exposure to Power BI or similar visualization tools. Experience supporting global or regional sales teams in a professional services, consulting, or B2B environment. Familiarity with sales KPIs such as pipeline, win rate, average deal size, and sales cycle metrics. Ability to clearly explain data and insights to non-technical stakeholders. Title: Senior AI Product Manager – GTM Solutions
Description: Job Description At Infoblox, every breakthrough begins with a bold “what if.” What if your ideas could ignite global innovation? What if your curiosity could redefine the future? So, what if the next big idea, and the next great career story, comes from you? Become the force that turns every “what if” into “what’s next.” In a world where you can be anything, Be Infoblox. Senior AI Product Manager – GTM Solutions We have an opportunity for a Senior AI Product Manager – GTM Solutions to join our Revenue Operations team in Mexico, reporting to the Revenue Operations Programs Director. In this hands-on role, you will discover high-impact opportunities across our global go-to-market organization and turn them into practical AI-powered products and workflows. You will work directly with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Revenue Operations teams to understand their challenges, define the right solutions, and build and prototype them using enterprise AI platforms. You will partner with Information Technology, Security, Data, and other teams when solutions require deeper integrations or production support. The ideal candidate combines business acumen, strong communication and collaboration skills, product judgment, and the technical ability to build. This is not a traditional program-management role: you will own the solutions themselves, from problem discovery and solution design through prototyping, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement. Be a Contributor — What You’ll Do Partner with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Revenue Operations leaders to understand their workflows, ask effective discovery questions, and identify high-value problems where AI can improve productivity, decision-making, pipeline management, forecasting, customer engagement, or operational efficiency. Frame business problems, validate opportunities, define desired outcomes, and prioritize AI product opportunities based on business value, feasibility, risk, and user needs. Design, build, test, and prototype AI agents, assistants, and workflow automations using approved enterprise AI platforms such as Claude, Glean, OpenAI, Gemini, or comparable tools. Translate business needs into user-centered solution designs, prototypes, and actionable product requirements; validate solutions with users and iterate based on feedback. Build practical solutions for account intelligence, sales productivity, pipeline management, forecasting, content generation, knowledge retrieval, customer engagement, and other GTM workflows. Own solutions from discovery through solution design, prototyping, production deployment, launch, adoption, monitoring, and continuous improvement. Partner with IT, Security, Data, and platform teams on integrations, architecture, governance, and production readiness; contribute hands-on to APIs, connectors, MCP, tool calling, or custom development when appropriate. Integrate Salesforce and other GTM applications, data sources, and enterprise systems to support secure, connected workflows. Apply prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, structured outputs, evaluation methods, and human-in-the-loop controls to improve solution quality and reliability. Establish testing, monitoring, documentation, and feedback practices; measure outcomes such as accuracy, usability, adoption, cycle-time reduction, quality improvement, and capacity returned. Ensure AI solutions comply with Infoblox security, architecture, privacy, data governance, and responsible-use standards. Communicate product decisions, technical concepts, trade-offs, and business impact clearly to both business and technical audiences. Be Prepared — What You Bring 5+ years of relevant experience in applied AI product management, AI solutions consulting, technical product management, business applications, automation, Revenue Operations, Business Operations, software or AI solution development, analytics, or a related field. Demonstrated hands-on experience building and prototyping AI agents, assistants, LLM-powered workflows, or comparable enterprise automation solutions. You can show what you have built and explain your contribution. Experience using enterprise AI platforms such as Claude, Glean, OpenAI, Gemini, or similar tools to create practical solutions. Strong product and problem-discovery skills: ability to understand ambiguous business challenges, identify user needs, define outcomes, and guide a solution from concept to launch and adoption. Strong communication, listening, facilitation, and collaboration skills, including the ability to work with business leaders and translate between business needs and technical solutions. Business and GTM understanding, including familiarity with B2B Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Revenue Operations, or related workflows. Working knowledge of LLMs, prompt engineering, agent workflows, tool calling, RAG, evaluation, and responsible AI practices. Experience integrating applications and data through APIs, connectors, webhooks, or similar technologies, and the judgment to partner with IT when deeper engineering is required. Experience taking AI solutions from prototype toward production, including testing, monitoring, security review, governance, and performance improvement. Familiarity with Salesforce; experience with GTM platforms such as Gong, Clari, or comparable revenue technology is a plus. Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field such as Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Science, Business Analytics, Business, Engineering, or a related discipline; equivalent practical experience may be considered. Be Successful — Your Path First 90 Days: Immerse in our culture, connect with mentors (Blox Buddies), and map the systems and meet with key stakeholders that rely on your work. Discuss and create short/long term goals Six Months: Establish trusted partnerships with key Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Revenue Operations, Information Technology, Security, and Data stakeholders Complete a prioritized inventory of GTM AI opportunities and define measurable success criteria for the highest-value use cases Deliver and launch initial AI agents, assistants, or workflow automations that improve productivity, decision-making, or operational efficiency Implement foundational testing, monitoring, documentation, governance, and user-feedback practices for production solutions Demonstrate measurable improvements such as reduced cycle time, improved quality, increased adoption, or capacity returned One Year: Scale a portfolio of reliable AI solutions across the global GTM organization Establish repeatable practices for AI discovery, prioritization, development, deployment, adoption, measurement, and continuous improvement Integrate AI solutions more deeply with Salesforce and other core GTM platforms to support account intelligence, pipeline management, forecasting, and customer engagement Build strong adoption through enablement, user feedback, and continuous refinement of solutions Provide leadership with clear reporting on business value, risks, adoption, and recommendations for future AI investments Serve as a trusted technical and strategic partner for responsible AI adoption across Revenue Operations Belong — Your Community Our culture thrives on inclusion, rewarding the bold ideas, curiosity, and creativity that move us forward. In a community where every voice counts, continuous learning is the norm. So, whether you code, create, sell, or care for customers, you’ll grow and belong here. Be Rewarded — Benefits That Help You Grow, Thrive, Belong Benefits designed to support your well-being and financial security, including IMSS social security coverage, paid time off, bonuses, and additional employee protections Grocery vouchers (Vales de Despensa) Employer‑supported savings fund with contributions designed to maximize your tax-advantaged savings Remote‑work support through a non‑taxable monthly home‑office stipend A monthly wellbeing and health‑support allowance that provides flexibility for your personal coverage needs For eligible field‑based roles: non‑taxable transportation support and fuel vouchers Learning opportunities, career-mobility programs, and leadership workshops Ready to Be the Difference? Title: Analyst Logistics Systems Configuration
Description: Job Description Ciudad de México Nivel de Estudios Bachelor’s degree in a STEM field; a logistics or supply chain degree is preferred. Experiencia Requerida 2+ years of experience in logistics, transportation, supply chain, systems support, data management, or a related analytical role; experience with TMS configuration or administration preferred. Experience using or supporting a TMS platform (Blue Yonder, Oracle, or SAP preferred) and/or Shipment Visibility tools, with strong quantitative, analytical, and problem-solving skills. Power BI experience and proficiency with the Microsoft Suite (particularly Excel); advanced English (reading, writing, and speaking) Habilidades ERP experience (SAP preferred) and hands-on experience with logistics software (YMS, WMS). Basic programming skills and experience with low/no-code platforms (Python, Postman, JavaScript). Experience with GPS tracking systems for transportation companies, including EDI & API communications. Logistics knowledge of truckload, rail, and/or marine transportation. Familiarity with GPS/IoT technologies, such as RFID and/or BLE tags, and their application in logistics. Experience with Agile development methodologies. Resumen The Analyst, Logistics Systems Configuration is responsible for supporting the configuration, implementation, and ongoing maintenance of the Transportation Management System (TMS), Shipment Visibility, Yard Management Systems (YMS), and Appointment Scheduling tools to streamline transportation processes across the integrated supply chain. Working as a system superuser and operational support resource, this role maintains master data, carriers, rates, and routes to align with business requirements while supporting timely and accurate shipment visibility. Covering multiple sourcing categories (can, ingredients, packaging, crowns, glass, reverse logistics, and finished goods) across all modes of transportation, the role contributes to the company’s logistics systems journey by adopting new technologies, methods, and processes. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, analytical, and comfortable coordinating with carriers, logistics service providers, IT, and internal business partners to resolve system and data issues. Responsabilidades TMS Configuration & Master Data Support system configuration and ongoing maintenance of master data, carriers, rates, and routes to align with business requirements and goals. Build and maintain automations for logistics systems tools using low-code and AI-assisted tools. This includes writing automated functional and regression tests in Playwright with GitHub Copilot to check SAP TM, Shipment Visibility and Appointment Scheduling, and creating Google Apps Script and Power Automate flows to remove repetitive manual tasks such as data extracts, notifications, report distribution and file uploads. Document requirements and business rules for each automation, test it before use, monitor runs and fix or escalate errors, and keep scripts, flows and procedures documented in the team repository and knowledge base so others can maintain them. Perform record/data audit functions to ensure compliance with policies and procedures. Maintain database(s) of logistics information, ensuring data quality and completeness. Shipment Visibility & Systems Support Support the implementation and ongoing management of logistics systems platforms to streamline transportation processes. Troubleshoot issues with data flow in TMS/SAP, WMS, YMS, Ortec, or other digital systems by identifying where the data failed, logging and prioritizing tickets by business impact, and escalating to IT, SAP consultants, the EDI team or external partners. Follow up on the corrective actions until closure, test fixes before they reach production, confirm with business users that the problem is resolved, and record root causes and fixes in the team knowledge base. Communicate with Shipment Visibility support teams and carrier GPS providers to guarantee successful onboarding and connection and implement solutions for shipment visibility and appointment scheduling issues with carriers. Data Analysis & Performance Collect, interpret, and analyze logistics data (product availability, transport and delivery reliability, sourcing and distribution) supporting the ~$1B logistics budget, and track product flow from origin to delivery via logistics systems. Track logistics KPIs and prepare performance reporting, including transit-time variance, shipment plan adherence, shipment visibility coverage, and cost per case, to support continuous process improvement and high-quality service. Cross-Functional Coordination & Training Work closely with IT and the business to deliver on CBI’s logistics systems journey Prepare and deliver training for internal and external users (such as plant and transportation teams, carriers and warehouses) of TMS, Shipment Visibility and Appointment Scheduling tools. This includes building training materials, step-by-step guides and quick reference documents, running hands-on sessions for new users, system changes or onboarding, and keeping attendance records. It also includes answering follow-up questions and gathering user feedback to update the materials and spot recurring issues.Communicate proactively with internal and external stakeholders to support issue resolution, status updates, and system adoption. Role-Specific Responsibilities: (≈20%) Document and analyze logistics processes and procedures (such as load planning, carrier tendering, appointment scheduling and freight settlement) using process maps and operational data (cost per case, on-time delivery, tender acceptance, detention hours) to find inefficiencies. Recommend improvements with their expected benefit and effort and, once approved, support their implementation through updated procedures, system configuration requests, user testing and training, to maximize delivery efficiency while minimizing costs. Monitor, log, and resolve operational incidents and exceptions (detentions, deviations, accidents, material damage, thefts, and production changes) by notifying plants, carriers and Security or Risk teams, and helping carry out other options such as reassigning loads, changing appointments or switching carriers to avoid disruptions to production schedules. Gather supporting documents for claims, check accessorial charges for rail car and truck shipments against contracts, dispute invalid charges and report recurring patterns by carrier, lane or facility. Participate in the planning, execution, and tracking of Logistics financial performance, and analyze the executability of the optimized network distribution design to provide operational insight. Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned, including but not limited to special projects and external partner presentations.
